info.title: CashKr Admin API — Geography 2
info.description: Tags: areas, cities, city, pincode, zones

get.description:
Combines internal leads and GA4 pincode_failed events landing on known-but-unserviceable pincodes, grouped by pincode and by city, with a separate aggregate for pincodes absent from the Pincodes table.

**Notes:** Reads Google Analytics 4 via lib/ga4 for pincode_failed events; if GA4 is unconfigured the route still succeeds with stats.ga4Available=false. GA4 carries no device dimension, so setting deviceType drops GA4 rows entirely (flagged as stats.ga4ExcludedByDeviceFilter). Also returns the full unpaginated list in `allPincodes`.

_Source: `app/api/areas/unserviced/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date (alias: startDate). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date (alias: endDate), extended to end of day.

parameters.name: timeSlot
parameters.description: Pickup slot filter (alias: pickupTime); 'all' disables it.

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Device filter (alias: device); 'all' disables it. Excludes GA4 data when set.

parameters.name: includeTest
parameters.description: Set 'true' to include test orders and the test pincode.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page for the flat pincode list.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Rows per page for the flat list.

get.description:
Returns the distinct, alphabetically sorted list of city names present in the pincodes table.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Takes no parameters.

_Source: `app/api/cities/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: Look up the city for a pincode
get.description:
Resolves a pincode to its city name from the pincodes table. Used to auto-fill the city when an address pincode is entered.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. An unmatched pincode returns 500 rather than 404 because the handler reads data[0].city without checking for an empty result. Error strings still say 'brands' - the file was copy-pasted from app/api/brands/route.ts.

_Source: `app/api/city/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: pincode
parameters.description: Pincode to resolve. Not formally required, but omitting it makes the route read the first row of the whole table.

example.details: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city')

post.description:
Despite living under /api/city, this handler validates and creates a row in the brands table - identical to POST /api/brands.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check. Copy-paste leftover from app/api/brands/route.ts - it writes to prisma.brands, NOT to a city table. Prefer POST /api/brands. Audited via withAuditLog as CITY.

_Source: `app/api/city/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.title: Sell old Apple mobile
example.description: Get the best price for your used iPhone.

get.summary: Look up a pincode's city and state
get.description:
Validates a 6-digit pincode and returns its city, state and serviceable device types from the Pincodes table.

_Source: `app/api/pincode/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: pincode
parameters.description: 6-digit Indian pincode; 400 if missing or malformed

error.message: Invalid pincode format. Pincode must be a 6-digit number.
Pincode not found in our database.

get.summary: List zones with pincode and vendor counts
get.description:
Paginated list of zones, newest first, each with a count of its pincodes and assigned vendors, optionally filtered by a name or city search.

_Source: `app/api/zones/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on zone name or city

post.description:
Creates a zone with a unique name, city and state, optionally connecting an initial set of pincodes by their Pincodes table UUIDs.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity ZONE), No handler-level auth check. pincodeIds are Pincodes row UUIDs, not pincode numbers.

_Source: `app/api/zones/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Missing name/city/state, or the zone name already exists

example.message: Zone with this name already exists

get.description:
Returns up to 100 pincodes with their city, state and currently assigned zone, filtered by a free-text search across city, state and the pincode number, and/or an exact city match.

**Notes:** Response is a bare array, not an object.

_Source: `app/api/zones/pincodes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on city or state; if numeric also matches the pincode exactly

put.description:
Sets zoneId on every Pincodes row whose pincode number appears in the supplied list, moving those pincodes into the given zone.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity PINCODE), No handler-level auth check. Moves pincodes out of whatever zone they were in previously.

_Source: `app/api/zones/pincodes/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: zoneId missing or pincodes not an array

example.message: Invalid request. ZoneId and pincodes array required.

put.description:
Applies a batch of coordinate updates, setting lat and lng on every Pincodes row matching each pincode number. Updates run as parallel updateMany calls, not one transaction.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity PINCODE), No handler-level auth check. `count` is the number of update operations issued, not rows changed. Not transactional — a mid-batch failure leaves partial updates applied.

_Source: `app/api/zones/pincodes/coordinates/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

get.summary: Get one zone with its pincodes
get.description:
Returns the zone including its full pincode list and a count of the vendors assigned to it.

_Source: `app/api/zones/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

put.description:
Updates the zone's name, city, state or description. When pincodeIds is supplied the zone's pincode set is REPLACED with exactly that list (Prisma `set`), not merged.

**Notes:** Audit-logged (entity ZONE), No handler-level auth check. Replacing pincodeIds changes coverage for every vendor holding this zone.

_Source: `app/api/zones/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

500.description: Update failed (also returned when the zone does not exist)

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the zone record.

**Notes:** Destructive, audit-logged (entity ZONE) but unauthenticated. Does not clean up VendorPincodes — use DELETE /api/vendors/{vendorId}/zones for that.

_Source: `app/api/zones/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

500.description: Delete failed (also returned when the zone does not exist)

SuccessErrorDetailsEnvelope.description: Error envelope `{ success: false, error, details }` where `details` is a string.

zoneId.description: Zone to assign the pincodes to

pincodes.description: Array of pincode numbers (strings or numbers; parsed with parseInt)

updates.description: Non-empty array of { pincode: number, lat: number, lng: number }

CodedErrorEnvelope.description: Structured error envelope `{ success: false, error: { code, message } }`.

MessageCountEnvelope.description: Acknowledgement `{ message, count }` for bulk operations.

name.description: Zone name; only applied when truthy

description.description: Free text; applied even when empty string

pincodeIds.description: Array of Pincodes table UUIDs; REPLACES the zone's whole pincode set
Array of Pincodes table UUID strings to connect on creation

MessageEnvelope.description: Message-only envelope `{ message }`; used for both success and failure responses.

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
